prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: DRAFT FOR OWNER REVIEW, one composite character identity sheet for the 2D CRPG Soul Meter. This explores unratified visual choices and establishes no canon.
Style/medium: gothic mythopunk; semi-realistic painted digital character illustration matching the Soul Meter Vex, Old Grumbrand, Korrath Ninefold and Ressa Quickfingers imagegen-source art: tactile worn materials, fine visible painterly grain, continuous tonal grade, believable volume and weight, muted Earth palette, charcoal and peat shadows, warm stone and cloth, restrained local accents. Like a painted classic CRPG character, never a flat graphic, UI icon, vector, cel cartoon, photograph or clean 3D render.
Lighting: single directional key light from upper-left with rich continuous shaded falloff; readable silhouettes, no pure-black outline. Background: opaque neutral mid-grey parchment, subtly textured, no environment, no transparent or checkerboard or green-screen ground.
Output: ONE composite PNG in landscape orientation, largest native landscape resolution the tool supports, full resolution. Keep all subjects fully inside margins with feet visible. No panels resembling UI. No lettering, captions, numbers, pseudo-writing, logos, watermarks or music notation, except the single word PROVISIONAL beside the scale bar on race sheets only. No bright generic high fantasy, no chibi/cartoon proportions, no flat lighting, no steampunk-dominant costume, no firearms, no Age-of-Stars machines, no Hollow bodies. Do not depict any deity. No extra image.
Composition: TWO large full-body healthy adult mortal race bases wearing the SAME CLASS KIT family, one on the left, the other on the right, at a gently elevated three-quarter/isometric-adjacent view, fully grounded and readable with feet visible. Between them, neatly spaced painted object studies show the canon weapon(s), the ONE regalia piece and the ONE identifying mark/accessory; include all canon auxiliary tools without inventing extra weapon classes. Every object is paint, not a flat vector. Neutral undyed working undershirt/trousers under kit; the kit attaches to anatomy and NEVER changes it. No helmets hiding race faces. No extra whole-body character, deity, image panel, scale bar, text, numbers, captions, lettering or pseudo-writing at all. Landscape composite, largest native resolution.
Class: Flamebinder; patron association Vicoar only, never a deity depiction. Canon kit: War pick, deployable kinetic-sculpture constructs.
LEFT wearer: kes-reth — lean healthy Ashborn adult with two ridged swept-back charcoal horns, warm umber-grey living skin, deep-set eyes and high cheek planes, one tapering tail and plantigrade feet, no active combustion, NO Mirror-Veil or reflective body.
RIGHT wearer: orthos — upright adult DRACONIC humanoid with short wedge muzzle and stepped brow plates, slate-olive scales, low swept-back horn ridges, muscular low tail, long forearms and broad clawed feet, NO WINGS, no machinery.
Allowed colour treatment: Copper Orange / Steel Gray, muted oxidized orange and soot-grey.
Canon WAR PICK, not axe, not hammer; pick head long narrow pointed beak on a compact dark iron shaft. Both wearers carry war picks. Also show a portable deployable kinetic-sculpture construct as a CLOSED folded pack beside an OPEN fixed-ground form in central object space: simple hand-forged hinged plates, gravity-loaded joints, plain load-bearing foot, inactive with no cannon, no firearm, no robot, no wheels, no new attack mechanism. This is a visual shape proposal only. One regalia piece: working heavy forge apron with tiny copper-orange edging, soot-grey body, visible tool wear. One accessory: a heat-tempered steel token with one proud imperfect test indentation, no letters/numbers. Materials cast iron, soot-blackened steel, restrained straw-to-blue temper bands, refractory clay accents; not brass or gears. Tiny residual ember near pick only, not whole-body fire. Kes'reth healthy horned umber-grey body, no mirror skin. Orthos scaled wingless body, no clockwork. No Age-of-Stars machine.

REVISION PRIORITY, overriding only the noted details in the initial brief: Edit the supplied Flamebinder sheet only. Preserve war picks, folded/open kinetic sculpture, forge aprons, two mortal race wearers, earth colours and upper-left painted light. On the LEFT Kes'reth, correct the horns to TWO ridged horns above temples sweeping BACK and slightly UP as in the race identity proposal, not curled ram horns; keep skin biological and opaque. Show the existing round imperfect-test steel token clearly WORN at the upper apron chest centre on BOTH wearers, on a short plain leather loop. This is the SAME single identifying accessory already shown in the object detail, not another new token design. Keep four-footed fixed-ground articulated construct, not a robot character or gun. No new equipment or text.
5. Avoid-list: pure-black outlines, flat/even lighting, cartoon/chibi proportions, bright
   generic high fantasy, steampunk-dominant material language, baked text/UI.
